daily.today_energy: Your emotional radar is extra sensitive today, Cancer. Lean into it. The cosmos is basically giving you permission to feel deeply without apologizing for it. Trust what your gut is telling you—it's rarely wrong.
daily.love: Someone in your orbit is picking up on your frequency. Whether you're single or coupled up, authenticity is your love language today. Show up as you actually are, not the version you think people want. That's the move.
daily.career: Your creativity is peaked right now. This is the energy to pitch that idea you've been sitting on or tackle a project from a fresh angle. Your contributions matter more than you realize today.
daily.health: Your body's asking for gentle movement and rest. Honor that. Whether it's a slow walk, stretching, or just sitting with tea, prioritize what makes you feel grounded and peaceful. Your vibe affects your whole system.

weekly.overview: This week's cosmic energy is asking you to lean into your intuition, Cancer. Things that felt foggy are becoming clearer, and your gut is basically your personal GPS right now. Trust the vibes you're picking up.
weekly.love: Someone's energy is shifting toward you, and honestly, you're feeling it before they even say anything. Whether you're single or coupled up, this is a week to be vulnerable about what you actually want.
weekly.career: Your ideas have serious weight right now. Don't sleep on that thought you had in the shower—bring it up in meetings or to the people who matter. Your voice is needed more than you realize.
weekly.health: Your body's asking for gentler movement and better sleep this week. Listen to what feels nourishing rather than punishing. Rest isn't laziness; it's you honoring your own frequency.
